title: Adopt with-connect integration harness, add Node.js Hello World
description:
Fixes #35

Migrates staging's integration tests to with-connect and adds a Node.js example:
- **with-connect harness:** replaces the compose-based setup with with-connect, which resolves the correct Connect image per version automatically (mirrors PR #355: https://github.com/posit-dev/connect-extensions/pull/355).
- **Node.js support:** the harness installs a Node runtime into the test Connect for `nodejs`-appmode extensions, since the published Connect images don't bundle one (mirrors PR #423: https://github.com/posit-dev/connect-extensions/pull/423).
- **Feed generation:** `extension-list.ts` derives an extension's `requiredEnvironment.nodejs` from `engines.node` in `package.json`, so the published gallery entry declares the Node.js version requirement.
- **Node.js hello-world example:** a minimal Node HTTP server, which becomes the only extension under CI and in the gallery feed.

Because `connect-staging-extensions` is where we should test one extension/example at a time until it's ready (after which it moves to `connect-extensions` for official publication/release), the two previously-tested extensions (`app-traces-jaeger-ui`, `champion-dashboard`) get a real `minimumConnectVersion` in place of the retired `connect-preview` placeholder, and they move off the gallery feed so that only the Node.js hello-world example publishes. The README was also edited to better document/explain this workflow.

## Validation

- **CI:** the migrated harness builds, deploys, and runs the hello-world through Connect on `preview`, `release`, and `2026.06.0`, all green. This confirms the with-connect migration and the Node-runtime provisioning step work end to end (Connect installs Node, starts the app, and the deploy succeeds).
- **dogfood:** deployed the hello-world bundle to dogfood directly; it serves `{"message":"Hello from Node.js on Posit Connect!"}`, and Connect renders it as Node.js content (Node.js logo). Confirms it runs on a real Node-enabled Connect, not just in CI.

title: Add the-stack and the-sprawl telemetry viewers
description:
## Summary
- **the-stack**: Single-page vertical layout with timeline histogram, trace table, and span detail panel. Everything stacked top-to-bottom with a top toolbar.
- **the-sprawl**: Multi-page layout with sidebar navigation, filter panel, and Vue Router. Traces, trace detail, and logs each get their own view.
- Both are FastAPI + Vue 3 apps that proxy Posit Connect's observability APIs (traces, logs, metrics) via `posit-sdk`. They accept a `?guid=<content-guid>` query param and use session token auth for Connect.

## Test plan
- [ ] Deploy both extensions to Connect
- [ ] Verify each loads with a valid `?guid=` param
- [ ] Verify traces, logs, and time filtering work under a subpath
- [ ] Verify missing GUID shows error message
- [ ] Verify missing OAuth integration (error 212) shows setup message
